units.source_text: 这正是催人哀思的时节，这位尚侍想必是情不自禁，故而不顾一切，偷偷地写这首诗派人送来，此心深可怜爱。

en.t: It was just the season to stir sorrowful thoughts, and this lady chamberlain must have been unable to restrain her feelings. Casting everything else aside, she secretly wrote this poem and sent it to him; such a heart was deeply touching and lovable.

units.source_text: 源氏大将便教这送信使者稍稍等待，命侍女打开安放中国纸的橱来，选取一张特等贡纸，又仔细挑选精致的笔墨，郑重其事地写回信，神情甚是艳雅。

en.t: General Genji then had the messenger wait a little, ordered a waiting woman to open the cabinet where the Chinese paper was kept, chose a sheet of especially fine tribute paper, carefully selected elegant brush and ink, and wrote his reply with great formality, looking exceedingly graceful as he did so.

units.source_text: 左右侍女见此模样，互相牵衣使眼，悄悄地问：“到底是写给哪一位的？”

en.t: Seeing him like this, the waiting women at his sides tugged at one another's sleeves, exchanged glances, and whispered, "Who in the world is he writing to?"

units.source_text: 源氏大将写道：“即使叠上芜函，终是无补于事。

en.t: General Genji wrote, "Even if I were to pile letter upon letter, in the end it would do no good.

units.source_text: 为此深自惩戒，已觉心灰意懒。

en.t: For that reason I have deeply reproached myself, and already feel dispirited and weary at heart.

units.source_text: 正拟独任其愁，岂意忽接来书。

en.t: I was just resolving to bear this sorrow alone, when unexpectedly your letter arrived.
